notes: Lazily builds aHashtable_6565 by re-scanning this object's already-decoded aByteArray6564 SMF track data with a MidiTrackReader: tracks running Bank-Select MSB/LSB controller values (status 0xB0, controller 0/32) and Program Change events (status 0xC0) per channel into local (bank<<-ish combined) program arrays, and for every Note-On event with velocity>0 (status 0x90) looks up/creates a FacingDirectionNode keyed by the channel's current (bank+program) id in aHashtable_6565, setting `.aByteArray6657[noteNumber] = 1`. Confirmed by MidiSequencePlayer.method2866, which calls this then iterates the resulting hashtable's FacingDirectionNode entries (id = aLong4291, note-usage bitmap = aByteArray6657) to selectively load only the SoundBankPatch samples actually referenced by this MIDI file (`class348_sub17.method2932(spriteArchiveLoader, is, node.aByteArray6657, 0)`). I.e. this precomputes 'which instrument patches, and which of their 128 note keys, does this track actually use' so only those samples need to be loaded.
